import KitFacts from "../../../../../components/ui/KitFacts.astro";

The web components kit is not built yet. [All frameworks](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/) lists the kits that are, and the [React kit](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/react/) covers the web.

The theme's `poweredBy` (`PolarisKey.theme({ poweredBy: "line" })`) adds the Polaris Locker line at the foot of the account pane and About; `"badge"` draws the 320 × 104 badge on About where 320 px are free. Off by default; never on a gate.
